title: Start a training match after a LAN guest joins
setup: Run two local copies with the same level. Enable Host on one copy so the match starts after the other copy joins and both test identities are bound. [Coordinated LAN setup](/coordinated-lan#host-the-lobby-and-bind-players)

title: Travel to the foundry when the lift arrives
setup: Connect the lift's arrival event to `arrive_at_foundry()`. When the destination loads, the travel panel names the new world. [World catalog setup](/coordinated-lan#prepare-the-world-catalog)
